rule.manual: You assign each new order yourself.
rule.in_turn: Available members get new orders one after another.
rule.evenly: Each new order goes to the available member with the fewest orders to call.

settings.title: Order assignment
settings.manual_help: New orders wait until you assign them to a member.
settings.in_turn_help: Available members get new orders one after another. Good when everyone works at the same pace.
settings.evenly_help: Each new order goes to the available member with the fewest orders to call. Faster members get more, and no one is overloaded.
settings.take_back: Reassign orders that aren't handled in time
settings.take_back_help: If a member doesn't handle a new order in time, it goes to another member so the customer is called quickly. Orders with a callback stay with their member.
settings.limit_help: After that, the order waits for you to assign it.
